title: A synthetic shared inbox, sorted and drafted for approval.

messages.body: Hi, one of the kitchen cupboard doors has come off its top hinge and won't close. Can someone take a look?
messages.draft: Work order for SYN-108: a kitchen cupboard door has come off its top hinge and won't close. Please rehang it, and tell us when you can attend so we can arrange access with the tenant.
messages.reason: A repair request that names the property and the fault. The draft is a work order for a contractor, and a property manager approves it and arranges access.

messages.body: Is the routine inspection still on for Tuesday morning? I'll be at work.
messages.draft: Task for SYN-117: the tenant asks whether Tuesday morning's routine inspection is still on, and says they'll be at work. Check the booking and reply to the tenant.
messages.reason: A question about a booked inspection. The automation can't see the inspection calendar, so it drafts a task for a property manager to check the booking and reply.

messages.subject: Repaint before the next lease
messages.body: The lease at SYN-120 ends in February. Before it's re-let, could you get a couple of quotes to repaint the kitchen and hallway? I'd like to see them before anything is booked.
messages.draft: Thanks. We'll ask two painters to quote for the kitchen and hallway at SYN-120 and send you both quotes. Nothing will be booked until you choose one.
messages.reason: A clear instruction from the owner. The update confirms the next step, and a property manager requests the quotes.

messages.subject: Invoice for the SYN-102 gutter clean
messages.body: Please find our invoice attached for the gutter clean at SYN-102, finished on Monday.
messages.reason: An invoice for a finished job. It's filed for the accounts team, who enter it in the property system. No reply is needed.

messages.body: Hi it's about the back fence again. The owner said last time you'd sort it out. Can you just go ahead?
messages.reason: Ambiguous: it asks for work to go ahead, but doesn't say what's wrong with the fence, and relies on an earlier promise that isn't in the inbox. A property manager decides, so no draft is written.

messages.subject: Keys for SYN-126 on Thursday
messages.body: We're booked to replace the rangehood light at SYN-126 on Thursday at 9am. Can we collect the keys from your office first?
messages.draft: Hi, the keys for SYN-126 will be at the front desk from 8:30am on Thursday. Please sign them out when you collect them and return them the same day.
messages.reason: A contractor asking for keys for a booked job. The draft confirms the pickup, and a property manager checks the booking before approving it.

messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance on Sunday night
messages.body: The synthetic owner portal will be unavailable from 11pm on Sunday to 1am on Monday for scheduled maintenance. No action is needed.
messages.reason: An automated notice that asks for no action. It's filed, with no reply.

messages.subject: Renewing our lease
messages.body: Our lease at SYN-140 ends in March. We'd like to stay for another year if the owner agrees. What do we need to do?
messages.draft: Owner update for SYN-140: the tenants have asked to renew their lease for another year when it ends in March. Please let us know whether you'd like to offer a renewal, and we'll reply to them.
messages.reason: A clear request to renew. The draft asks the owner, because the owner decides; a property manager replies to the tenants once the owner has answered.

trace.label: Read
trace.detail: Read the new mail in the shared mailbox and the after-hours SMS line, read-only

trace.label: Sort
trace.detail: Gave each message a category, an action and the reason for both

trace.label: Check
trace.detail: Found the message with no clear request and sent it to a property manager, with no draft

trace.label: Draft
trace.detail: Drafted a work order, a task, two owner updates and a reply to a contractor, from the office's own templates

trace.label: Hold
trace.detail: Held every draft for a property manager's approval, so nothing was sent

trace.label: Log
trace.detail: Recorded each step's input, output and time in this trace
